# Intercampus Shuttle

The shuttle is free with a valid ASU Sun Card.

### Tempe - Downtown Phoenix

Stops: Tempe Transit Center, Taylor Place, University Center

Runs: Monday - Friday, 6:30 a.m. - 11 p.m., every 20 minutes

### Tempe - West Valley

Stops: Apache Boulevard and Rural Road, Fletcher Library

Runs: Monday - Friday, 6 a.m. - 10:30 p.m., every 30 minutes

## Weekend service

| Route | Stops | Runs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Polytechnic Express](https://cfo.asu.edu/shuttles/polytechnic) | Tempe Transit Center, Sutton Hall | Saturday - Sunday, 8 a.m. - 8 p.m., hourly |

Routes do not run on university holidays.
